name: MSM parity GameTests
description: Behaviour-parity GameTests over the sample mods' public behaviour (vanilla and Fabric API only); run by tools/run-fabric-server --gametest (with --gametest-filter msm_parity_tests:sample_mod_*, sample_mob_*, sample_creatures_*, sample_machines_*, sample_portals_*, sample_particles_*, sample_rules_*, sample_vehicles_*, sample_vanilla_blocks_*, sample_villagers_*, sample_plants_and_storage_*, sample_mobs_and_commands_*, sample_game_modes_*, sample_community_games_* or sample_script_*; worldgen_parity_* with the msm_worldgen_parity_fixture jar as the mod under test, by the parity build's worldgenParity and worldgenVanilla tasks; live_views_data_parity_test_* with the msm_live_views_fixture jar, by its liveViewsParity task; structures_parity_test_* with the msm_structures_parity_fixture jar, by its structuresParity task) against a content jar and an ejected jar (sample_script_*, sample_particles_script_*, sample_rules_script_*, sample_vanilla_blocks_script_*, sample_mobs_and_commands_traders_* and sample_mobs_and_commands_script_* against content jars only; sample_vehicles_* too, as vehicles are not ejected).
